You owe the Company $2,000,000.

They took your land and left you a drill. You pay them back in ore, one quota at a time. Miss a quota and you're fired.

GreeDrill is a drilling roguelike where every cell is a bet, and every quota raises the stakes.

Dig, or go back up?

Every cell you drill fills your hold. The deeper you go, the more it pays, and the hotter it gets. Overheat and your hull takes the hit. Go up now and the load is yours. Dig one more time and all of it is still on the line.

That choice is the whole game, and it never gets easier.


Each world changes one rule. In the Ice, drilling an ice block sends you sliding straight down to the first cell that isn't ice. Each block you slide through adds +50% to the ore where you land, up to +100%.

The Bailiff


You paid your quota? The Company checks your books. The Bailiff seizes 70% of your surplus. You keep 30%.

The seized money is locked in crates at the bottom of a shaft. Go down, strap the crates to your drill and get back up before he catches you. Each crate you bring back returns its share. Bring back all of them and you get 10% more.

Five worlds, five Guardians

Earth, Desert, Rock, Ice, Magma. Each world has its own rule, and at the bottom of each one waits its Guardian. The Company would rather send you than go itself. Five fights, and no two play the same.


On the way down, you can run into six mini-bosses. Each one fights in its own arena, with its own trick to figure out.

Relics with a catch


At the counter you buy relics, and many of them have a downside. The Miner's Bet flips a coin every time you go up: 6 chances in 10 to double your hold. Otherwise you lose all of it.

The garage


There are 74 drills to collect. Each one has a bonus and a drawback, written in two short lines under the lamp. Most of them are for sale. Eight can only be earned through objectives.

Between runs you also grow the camp and buy Company licences. A licence stays yours for good.

Speedrun and Endless

In Speedrun, everyone plays the same mine for 30 days, with its own worldwide leaderboard. Then a new mine replaces it. In Endless, mines are random and there is no final quota: you go as deep as you can, on a separate leaderboard. Your drill has no effect in either mode, so everyone starts equal.

A game made by one person.

Greed Forest TD is a tower defense roguelite where the forest is teeming with gold and danger, and you are Buildy, a greedy little machine.
Wall off the wildlife with huge mazes of towers, dig up everything that glitters, and collect the gold from every creature that tries to stop you.

But how much gold does a squirrel carry?

More than you'd think.

Set your spells to autocast and casually watch the night unfold, or cast spells by hand and build mid-battle. Most maps take 10-20 minutes, with the option of entering endless mode to push your run to the limit and see how you rank against other players.

Build by Day, Survive by Night

Take your time to build a maze, throw down gold extractors, and upgrade towers with unique attack effects. Start the night, and watch the forest pour in.

Bleed the Forest Dry

Your emitter draws the forest's creatures, and every sunrise you can increase its signal for bigger threats and bigger bounties. Advance deeper one map at a time, unlocking new spells and powerups as you go.

The Forest Fights Back

On siege maps the enemies attack your buildings. Fight back by combining towers into monstrous stacks, or Spirit Link them to Buildy and carry their firepower into battle yourself.

We think you'll love Greed Forest if you enjoyed:

Warcraft III tower defenses, Element TD, Legion TD, GemCraft, Rogue Tower, Emberward, Isle of Arrows, Bloons TD 6, Kingdom Rush, Thronefall, They Are Billions, Megabonk, and Vampire Survivors

HOW DEEP WILL YOUR GREED TAKE YOU?

Greedspire doesn't fight you. It tempts you.

Every floor of the spire hides ten fog-shrouded rooms. Clear four, and the way down opens: bank your gold, gear up, descend. But the spire always whispers the same thing: one more room. Rooms five through ten pay better. They also hit harder. Nobody makes you open them. You will anyway.

There is no way back. The only way out of Greedspire is down.

CHOOSE YOUR OWN RISK - EVERY SINGLE FIGHT

Before each battle, a timing bar decides your fate - and you decide the timing. Stop it safe for a x1 fight, or catch a razor-thin window for x2 or x3: more enemies, more pressure, and far, far more gold. That half-second of nerve is the whole game in miniature: how greedy are you feeling right now?

FIGHT FAST. CHOOSE SLOWLY.

Combat is a lightning-fast auto-battle where your build does the fighting - and you make the clutch calls. Unleash your hero's signature ability, crack a one-per-floor weapon art, or slam an Execution Oil for one guaranteed, fight-ending critical. Every cleared room drops loot, and every trophy is a real decision: equip it, stash it, or fence it for gold. Seven equipment slots. 700 treasures with randomized rolls. Zero mercy for hoarders.

FORGE IT TO +20. OR WATCH IT SHATTER.

Any weapon, any armor, any ring - every piece you carry can be enchanted all the way to +20, multiplying its power up to +360%. The first three taps are safe. Every strike after that is a test of nerve - and failure destroys the item forever, leaving you half its worth in shards. Your +9 blade is one scroll away from godhood and one scroll away from dust, and the spire knows exactly which one you'll believe in. The greediest decisions in Greedspire aren't made in combat. They're made at the anvil.

GREED IS A CHOICE. WE MADE IT A BUTTON.

After every cleared floor, the game offers exactly two options: UPGRADES & SHOP - bank your loot, gear up, and take the stairs down… or GREED SPIRE - stay on this floor and push into its deadlier rooms for escalating rewards. Most runs don't end because the spire was too strong. They end because you pressed the second button one time too many.

FIVE SINNERS. ONE SPIRE.

  • Giltbound - the safe opener whose rusted blade turns caution into momentum

  • Aurum Seer - reads the spire's greed and squeezes every rich reward dry

  • Iron Votary - patience made iron: restraint today, a guaranteed crit tomorrow

  • Veil Dancer - thrives on low risk, punished for recklessness - the anti-greed gambit

  • Debtweaver - bends every price in the spire's economy in their favor

Five starting builds, five rule-changing passives, five completely different answers to the same temptation.

DESCEND THROUGH A DROWNED ECONOMY

100 floors. Five realms of a civilization that worshipped gold until gold answered back: the Rusted Gate, the Tithe Catacombs, the Sunken Treasury, the Gilded Abyss, and the Crown Vault. Ten bosses stand the watch - from the Coinwarden at the gates to the Heart-Crowned Sovereign at the very bottom, ready to audit your run in blood.

DEATH IS TOTAL. FAME IS FOREVER.

When your hero dies, everything goes: gold, gear, enchants, depth. No meta-currency drip, no account power - the next hero starts from nothing but your own nerve and knowledge. All that survives is the Hall of Fame: ten legendary corpses, ranked forever. Getting on that list means beating heroes you yourself built. Staying on it means going deeper next time.

KEY FEATURES

  • Push-your-luck core loop: descend with your loot, or linger on every floor for richer, deadlier rooms

  • Set your own difficulty every fight by stopping the risk bar at x1, x2 or x3

  • High-risk enchanting: hone any gear to +20 for up to +360% power - one failed strike destroys it forever

  • Fast auto-battles with clutch hero abilities, item actives and combat provisions

  • 700 items across 7 equipment slots with randomized rolls - every run builds different

  • 5 heroes with rule-changing passives and their own risk appetites

  • 100 floors, 5 hand-crafted realms, 10 bosses

  • True permadeath, zero account power creep - and a top-10 Hall of Fame

  • Short, dense runs built for "one more hero"

The spire is patient. It has all the gold in the world - and it knows exactly what you'll do to get it.

Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways. Explore tropical islands and wrestle with wobbly physics to haul gold and goods back to meet the captain’s demands. Work together to earn exclusive upgrades and access to new exotic excursions, while pocketing a little on the side to fund your shopping sprees. Every trip is a laugh!
Features

  •  Ship Shenanigans: Claim your room, grab a drink, and get the passengers dancing. Goof around on deck and check off activities while your party sleeps off yesterday’s excursion.

  •  Island Adventure: Explore cozy islands full of secrets and loot them absolutely dry.

  •  Phunky Physics: A physics sandbox that constantly creates chaotic, meme-able mistakes.

  •  Teamwork... Mostly: Hit the captain’s quota together, or slip a few gems into your own pockets on the sly.

  •  Shop Till You Ship Out: Earn exclusive upgrades, rooms with better views, and new excursions while spending your haul on outfits nobody asked to see you wear.

Work Together, Shop Separately
The captain asks that guests collect treasure across a variety of island excursions. Pull together to hit the quota and you’ll upgrade your pass, unlocking nicer rooms and access to more exotic destinations. But also, nobody’s stopping you from pocketing a little extra to fund your next shopping spree.
A Physics Playground
Forget rigid, scripted puzzles. This is an interactive playground where hilarious, unpredictable physics dictate the action. If you can see it, you can probably grab it, throw it, or swing it.

Trapped in the Dark

You awaken confused on a dead mining vessel. Mutated horrors stalk the shadows, heavy breathing echoes through the overhead vents, and your flashlight is slowly dwindling away. Every step into the dark could be your last. Can you navigate the decks and reach the escape pod?

Survival Features

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Horror: Immerse yourself in deep-space dread driven by dynamic lighting, terrifying sound design, and the constant threat of watching shadows move across the walls.

  • Unpredictable Threats: Evade and survive against intelligent monsters lurking around every blind corner.

  • Hardcore Resource Management: Ration scarce inventory, track power breakers, and make every critical survival choice count before your light goes out.

  • Multi-Deck Exploration: Navigate decks 1 through 5, uncover hidden items, and monitor the facility using integrated security camera systems.

  • Escalating Tension: Experience a harrowing singleplayer journey where the danger grows heavier the deeper you delve into the wreck.

Story

You are Chodnii, and you must escape Cube Island.

Combat

You can use normal attacks, spirit skills, and god skills, while also jumping and dodging to outmaneuver your enemies.

Skills

Spirit skills and god skills are powerful attack abilities. Every time you clear a portal, you can get new spirit skills and god skills — and even unlock the second kind of combat modes.

Enemies

Your enemies are immensely powerful, but with your skill and determination, you will overcome them.

This game uses Unreal Engine 5's Lumen and Nanite technologies to deliver dynamic lighting and highly detailed environments.

🧪 Green Gas

Not everyone is your friend.

Green Gas is a multiplayer social–strategy game where trust is the most fragile and dangerous resource.

In each match, players take on the role of Cells, working together to repair the main generator —

but hidden among them is a Cancer, whose goal is the exact opposite…

Roles

Cells

Cooperate to repair the generator

Collect money and resources

Identify and eliminate the Cancer before it’s too late

Cancer

Sabotage and create chaos

Steal money

Use toxic gas, traps, and deception

Prevent the generator from being fully repaired or eliminate the Cells

Win Conditions

✅ Cells Win By:

Repairing the generator to 100%

Or successfully eliminating the Cancer

❌ Cancer Wins By:

Preventing the generator from being completed

Or eliminating the Cells before repairs are finished

Money, Tools, and Sabotage

How does the Cancer grow stronger?

Stealing money from rooms

Transporting money through underground tunnels to their personal account

Spending money on:

- Green toxic gas or toxic water

- Traps to hunt or slow down Cells

- Deception, lies, and misinformation

If the Cells remain confused and waste time → the Cancer wins.

- Cell Objectives

Collect money and deliver it to the main room

Gather metals and convert them into money

Buy keys to unlock sealed rooms for more resources

Purchase tools to repair the generator faster

Coordination, healthy suspicion, and timely decisions are vital

- Toxic Gas – Will You Survive?

Being exposed to green toxic gas doesn’t always mean instant death.

Each time you enter toxic gas:

A mini-game is triggered

Win it → you survive

Lose it → you are eliminated

- Generator Progress Stages

🔸 50%

Cells may hold a vote only once

If the Cancer is correctly eliminated → instant Cell victory

If the vote is wrong → an innocent Cell is eliminated

If no vote is held, the opportunity expires permanently after 120 seconds

🔸 70%

A baseball bat spawns randomly in a hard-to-reach area of the map

It can be used only once

If used incorrectly:

The bat breaks

An innocent Cell is killed

🔸 90%

The Cancer enters Power Phase

All collected money is doubled for 6 minutes

The Cells’ final chance…

⚠️ Decisions & Risks

- Wrong vote = losing a teammate

- No vote = losing your last chance

- Wrong swing = killing an innocent Cell

- Money in Cancer’s hands = faster defeat for the Cells

- Cosmetic & General Features

Change body color

Change tie color

Fun and expressive animations

- Final Thoughts

In Green Gas,

Cells survive through cooperation and suspicion,

while the Cancer wins through lies, chaos, and wasted time.

Trust is fragile —

and every mistake has a cost.

Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold, inspired by Harventure, It's Chopping Time! and Keep on Mining! Start with a single tree on a tiny island, gather everything you fell, and spend it all on upgrades that grow your world into a sprawling island. Cozy on the surface, with a splash of insanity waiting in the late game.

Chop, break, mine

Chop wood, break stones and mine gold. Everything you fell drops loot, and every drop fuels your next upgrade.

Upgrade and grow

Spend your materials in a deep upgrade tree. Unlock new tools, hit harder and gather faster.

Expand your island

Watch a single tile grow into a sprawling island, opening up more trees, stones and gold to work through as it expands.

Unleash mayhem

Cozy, with a splash of insanity. Pick a weapon that changes how you play, then push into the late game. Call down lightning, beams and falling boulders, and tear through the final chapters.

Features

  • A cozy, stylized 3D isometric world that grows as you play

  • A satisfying incremental loop: mine, upgrade, expand, repeat

  • Six weapons with active abilities and deep upgrade paths

  • A relaxing pace, with room for min-maxers to optimize

  • Fully playable in 9 languages

GRENADE! is a party game for up to 8 players. During every match the crowd keeps throwing grenades and bombs into the arena, along with banana peels, eggs and drinks. Survival is the main mode: dodge the grenades, throw them back and be the last one standing. You can also mix kart races, sports and an obstacle course into the same match.

Catch and throw back


Every grenade that lands goes off after 5 to 15 seconds, and picking it up doesn't stop the countdown. With empty hands, the throw button catches a grenade out of the air so you can send it straight back. Throw it flat, lob it over walls or bank it off them, or get close to another player, lift them up and throw them.

Survival


The last player left wins the round. After 60 seconds SUDDEN DEATH starts and the grenades fall faster and faster. There are five maps: Concrete Dome, Crumble Dock with a floor that breaks apart, a mansion Terrace, Octopus Hell with a giant octopus, and an aircraft Carrier where you can pick up and throw small fighter jets.

Chain reactions and highlights


One grenade can set off other grenades, BOMBs and barrels one after another. Longer chains push the announcer from SUPER SHOT! up to GODLIKE!!!!!!!!, and chain reactions, multi-kills and ring-outs replay automatically after each round.

Kart


Three tracks with starting boosts and drift boosts. Carry two of ten items, including grenades, BOMBs, bananas, a magnet and a ghost.

Sports


Football, basketball, ice hockey, beach volleyball and speed skating, with grenades still flying in. Getting caught in a blast sends you flying instead of knocking you out.

Obstacle Run


A 250 m course made of seven sections that get shuffled every round, with bombs raining down near the end. Fall into the water and you restart from the last checkpoint.

Animal friends


Pick your favorite from a whole bunch of animal friends. The first time you play, an animal friend walks you through the basics, and you can put up to eight emotes on your emote wheel.

Play together

  • Online matches for up to 8 players. Jump into a Quick Game, or create a room and send your friends the invite code.
  • Free for all or teams, 1 to 5 rounds. The host picks the event and map for each round.
  • Fill empty seats with bots on Easy, Normal or Hard.
  • Keyboard and mouse or controller.

GRENCH BOSS

I only stole ONE small tool...!!

But in greenskin society, stealing means execution on the spot. I was sure I was dead for real.

Then I opened my eyes on an island of pirate rats. I will get back home somehow, and I WILL have my revenge. (Okay, I did the wrong thing first. Still.)

BUILD YOUR DEFENSE

Place turrets on the road where the enemies come. Turrets can be upgraded.

FIGHT WITH YOUR OWN HANDS

Sometimes you must grab your wrench and fight the enemies yourself. Watch out for the real badasses.

MEET THE WORKERS, "KKOMU"

They gather resources for you. Their arms and legs are very, very weak, though.

THE ESSENCE OF GOBLIN ENGINEERING: VEHICLES

Ride your vehicle and go everywhere you want. A wall is blocking your way? Just blast through it with the terrain manipulator.

The demo includes early versions of two small sandboxes. Ride a kart and shoot the terrain beam, and fly in the sky with an airship. Also:

  • Character customization to make your very own goblin

  • Many control styles inspired by TPS, MMO, ARPG and AOS games

  • Languages: English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Japanese, French

The game is in active development. It is still missing a lot, but for the full version I will improve really many things and add more enemies, equipment, vehicles and turret upgrades. I make this game alone, so every opinion helps a lot. Thank you for all your feedback, bug reports and interest!

A deep front-office football sim for people who think the real game happens in the war room and on the cap sheet.

The whole job. None of the joystick.

You're the general manager. You draft, trade, sign, cut, and extend. You hire the coaches, set the scheme, and answer to an owner who's counting wins. Then the games are played out snap by snap, and you live with the results. You'll never throw a pass. You'll decide who throws them for the next ten years.

  • One franchise, 31 AI rivals, and a league that runs for decades.
  • Every game simulated play by play. Open any drive and walk it snap by snap, name by name.
  • You set tendencies, never plays: lean on the run, blitz more, go for it on fourth. The coaches call it and the film tells you if it worked.
  • Five ways to start: a fresh build, an aging contender, a teardown, a war chest, or a capped-out mess.

You never see the true ratings. Nobody does.

There's no overall number anywhere in the game. Every player you haven't done the work on reads as a range: attributes, ceiling, even personality. Scouting narrows it. Playing time narrows it. Your own long-time players read clearly; the rival's rookie you're about to trade for does not. The AI works under the same fog. It over-rates its own guys and misreads yours, so a sharp eye is a real weapon.

  • Fogged attributes that tighten as you scout, watch tape, and live with a player.
  • Two scouts with their own leanings. Point them at a draft class, a rival roster, or free agents.
  • The board lies. Steals and busts surface over seasons, not on draft day.

Draft night is a bloodsport.

Build your big board, then run the war room live: the clock bleeding, picks coming off, rivals calling with offers. Trade up when your guy is sliding. Trade down when the value is wrong. First-rounders usually arrive close to what they'll become; a seventh-rounder who sticks is a scouting win you earned.

  • A live, paced draft with trade offers in real time.
  • A report card the night of the draft, and a retrospective years later when the careers are real.
  • Late rounds are a gauntlet. Most won't make it. Finding the one who does is the job.

Grow them yourself.

Development is where dynasties are won. Put a young player on a development plan and pay for it in your coaches' limited focus. Set him goals: sharpen a skill, build his frame, learn the system, grow up. Pair him with a veteran mentor. Some kids take off early, some plateau, some bloom at 27, and some never close the gap. When the season ends, the Development Report tells you who grew, who stalled, and why, before you make a single offseason decision.

  • Development plans with goals, progress bars, and a real cost in coaching attention.
  • Traits a player is born with, earns, or picks up from a mentor, and each one does something.
  • Aging that's real: legs go first, savvy lasts, and quarterbacks and kickers hold on longest.

Every dollar tells the truth.

The cap is the one opponent that never gets hurt. Signing bonuses, guarantees, void years, dead money. Every contract is a bet, and the books always come due. Restructure today and you've mortgaged two years from now. Tag your cornerstone for one more season, or let him walk to a division rival.

  • Base, bonus, guarantees, void years, restructures, and spread cuts.
  • The cornerstone tag, a cap that grows every offseason, and a championship premium when your winners want paying.
  • Re-sign your own, raid free agency in waves with bidding wars, or build through the draft.

Your players have a pulse.

A 53-man roster is 53 personalities. Underpay your star in his walk year and he holds out. Bench a proud veteran for a rookie and the locker room picks a side. Work ethic, ego, and temperament stay hidden until they cost you, and by then he's either winning you games or losing you the room. The big moments land as one-sheet decisions, and some options cost nothing today except your word. The game writes the promise down, and he remembers.

  • Holdouts, trade demands, and locker-room chemistry that changes results.
  • Character events with real outcomes: lasting marks, temporary wounds, promises with deadlines.
  • Motivation, composure, and form that rise and fall across a season.

Thirty-one GMs who play the same game.

Every AI franchise knows where it stands: All-In, Competing, Retooling, or Rebuilding, and it acts like it. Contenders buy veterans at the deadline. Rebuilders sell them for picks. Teams fight for every roster spot, through free agency and camp and all season long. And they remember. Insult the same GM with lowballs and he stops taking your calls. Catch one on the hot seat and he'll take less than fair to save his job.

  • Rival GMs with distinct styles, blind spots, rapport, and grudges.
  • A living trade market: offers, feelers, counters, and deadline deals.
  • AI teams that draft, develop, and manage the cap under the same rules you do.

The owner is always watching.

Every season the owner sets a mandate. Hit it and win to buy yourself room. Miss it and the seat gets warm fast. Lose long enough and you're cleaning out your desk, though a struggling franchise across the league might call with a second chance.

  • Owner trust, season mandates, and a hot seat that's real.
  • Get fired, then choose: take another job, or retire on your legacy.
  • A GM career that spans franchises, not just one save.

Build something that outlives you.

Anyone can win once. The dynasty is the pick you nailed in year two paying off in year eight: the homegrown star you watched go from raw to the Hall of Fame, the core you kept together while everyone said sell.

  • Decades-long saves with league history, records, and a Hall of Fame.
  • Awards races all season: MVP odds, candidate cards, the Pro Bowl and All-League teams.
  • A trophy case and a permanent Legacy score. Homegrown greatness counts for more than rentals.

Your league. Your logos.

Gridiron Grit ships with a fully fictional 32-team league. Want it to look like the one in your head? League Packs are a folder drop away: swap every team's name, city, colors, and logo, and even the player-name pools.

  • Plain-folder mods. No tools, no rebuild. Share one as a zip.
  • Built to be Workshop-friendly.

Deep, not buried.

Hover anything and a card explains it; hover a term inside that card and another opens beside it. An in-game wiki covers every system. The depth is there when you want it and out of the way when you don't.

Try the whole thing.

The demo isn't a slice. It's the full game through your first complete season and offseason: the draft, free agency, camp, all of it. Your save carries straight into the full game.

Eternity has a queue. You're the one moving it along.

You're the newest intern at the Bureau of Afterlife Assignment, and the dead are not going to sort themselves. Souls arrive as case files - a name, a cause of death, and a short, frequently incriminating list of life deeds. Read each one, check today's rulebook, and stamp them to their destination before the timer runs out and the queue backs up into something Management would like to "circle back on."

Six stamps. Six fates.

Heaven, Hell, Purgatory, and Reincarnate - and, because the Bureau believes in consequences, Customer Service and Middle Management. The last two are not metaphors. They are departments.

The rulebook changes every shift.

It is always reasonable, and it never quite agrees with itself. Politicians go to Hell - unless they were kind to interns. The pious ascend - unless they filed late. By the final act you'll be reconciling six contradictory directives against a ticking clock while the Bureau commends your "flexibility."

Cosmic admin, narrated in HR-speak.

Eternal judgment run like a soul-crushing open-plan office. The Bureau is cheerful, helpful, and quietly monstrous. You will do unspeakable things to strangers' eternities, and you will be thanked for your continued service.


  • 75 hand-written souls across a 12-shift campaign in three acts.
  • An escalating rulebook where every new directive contradicts the last.
  • A timer that makes it funny, not hard - difficulty comes from the rules, not your reflexes.
  • Six bureaucratic destinations, each with its own deadpan consequence.
  • Writing that never breaks character and never lets you feel good about your promotions.


Welcome to the Bureau. Your eternity has been processed. Theirs is up to you.

Spell Cards aren’t drawn from a deck—they’re ingredients you combine into new magic.

Discover powerful spells through different recipes, then wield your creations as you climb the Tower of Starlight.

Ray came to the tower for one reason to bring her missing mother home. But when she was caught in the tower’s magic, most of the power she carried was scattered. Now she must recover her lost magic as she climbs.

  • Recover Your Scattered Magic

Collect basic elemental Spell Cards as you climb the tower. Combine two cards through different

recipes to discover new magic, ranging from simple tactical tools to powerful spells.

Spell Cards are not a combat deck that gets shuffled before every battle. They are ingredients used

to create stronger magic. The first time you combine a spell, it is recorded in your Spell Library.

Review its recipe, gather the right materials during a future expedition, and craft the spell again

when you need it.

  • Fight with Four Elements

Build Burn with Ember and overwhelm your enemies. Recover and disrupt the enemy’s plans with Aqua.

Endure incoming attacks and strike back with Terra, or build Echo with Gust to unleash repeated

damage.

Combine elements, read enemy intents, and manage your Action Points, HP, and MP. With limited Action

Points each turn, decide whether to attack, defend, craft a spell, use a consumable, or meditate.

  • Find Your Own Way Up the Tower

Choose your next destination along paths filled with battles, elite encounters, events, shops, rest

sites, Card Sanctuaries, treasure chests, and bosses.

Collect relics and consumables, rearrange your active and reserve spells for the situation ahead,

and prepare for the next battle. Even the same path can demand a different solution depending on the

spells, relics, and choices you discover.

  • Growth That Remains Between Expeditions

When you complete an expedition, combine the Spell Cards you earn to discover spells that remain

recorded in your Spell Library. Use the Memory Shards gathered during your expeditions to strengthen

Ray, and work with Sally to expand the support and starting choices available on future attempts.

Return to the Wanderers’ Garden, meet the people gathered there, and prepare a new strategy before

entering the tower again.

  • Confront the Memories Left in the Tower

People say the Tower of Starlight reveals what has been lost.

In Ray’s memories, her mother was endlessly kind. Ray climbs with only the belief that her mother is

somewhere inside the tower. But the higher she goes, the traces she discovers begin to point toward

a truth that conflicts with her warm memories of childhood.

Awakening in a forest clearing rescued by a passing Ranger, you begin your journey to discover what happened to your friends and family, and what stirs under the villages and cities of Grimrain. Explore the world through a variety of story quests, follow treasure maps across mountains and tundra to unearth loot, powerful foes and mysterious dungeons.

COMBAT SKILLS

Build your character to fit your playstyle with a combat skills system - train in elemental magics, melee, the occult, or healing, stealth, and defensive abilities:

  • Elemental - Torch your enemies or freeze them to the spot.

  • Witchcraft - Crippling diseases, necromancy, curses, and the power of the void.

  • Melee - Chop, stab, stomp, kick and punch and bash.

  • Defensives - Shield yourself and your party from incoming physical and magical attacks.

  • Healing - Mend wounds, remove poisons, heal bleeding, and craft field dressings and potions to keep everyone in the fight.

CRAFTING AND GATHERING SKILLS

Gather materials from around the game world and craft them into potions, weapons, armour, enchants, trinkets, and more.

  • Mining - Scour moutains and mines for stone, ores, and gems.

  • Woodcutting - Chop down trees, shrubes and bushes to turn into carpentry materials.

  • Botany - Collect and identity herbs and roots for cooking or brewing.

  • Brewing - Boil up potions, remedies and tinctures.

  • Smelting - Turn ores into metals and magical alloys.

  • Armour smithing - Create combat clothing out of metal or leather.

  • Cooking - Create delicious stews, hearty meals, and rejuvenating drinks for yourself and your party.

INSTANCED DUNGEONS

Create a party of friends and fight through caverns, caves, and forests, guarded by dungeon bosses and their underlings. Instance scaling allows flexible party sizes and compositions

OPEN-WORLD DUNGEONS AND WORLD BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Sit back and watch your character tear through hordes of enemies while you focus on the most satisfying part of a loot-driven game: finding stronger equipment and gradually bringing your ideal build to life.

Automated Combat, Effortless Looting

Once you enter a dungeon, your character will automatically explore, fight, and use skills. Create Your Own Skill Setup

Discover a Wide Variety of Item Affixes

Build Across Multiple Systems and Keep Growing

A Lightly Dark Fantasy World

Abilities

You are the commanding officer of an Allied heavy bomber group in the skies over occupied Europe. The Wing hands you a field order and a finite number of men and machines. Which targets you strike, which crews you send, when you push and when you stand down is up to you.

Group Commander is a player-paced command simulation. There are no timers and no background clock ticking against you. Every phase of every mission traces back to a decision you made: at the briefing table, over the target, and in the debrief when the returns come in ragged.

Plan the raid

Each week the Wing deals a fresh board of targets: ball-bearing works, U-boat pens, marshalling yards, aircraft plants. Read the dossier, weigh flak and fighter cover against the reward, and commit your formation.

Fly it, one decision at a time

Watch the raid unfold as a mission profile above the ops log. Fighters come in waves. Flak walks across the formation. An engine throws a rod; the oxygen fails at altitude; the navigator goes down and the course drifts. Press on, divert to the secondary, or bring them home the call is yours.

Carry the cost

Losses are not a number. A downed fort takes named men with it killed, or bailed out and posted missing. Shipmates grieve, green replacements need bedding in, and every fallen man files a letter home that lands on your desk for your signature. Crews fatigue, lose form, break down and, if they live long enough, rotate home at the end of their tour. Shorten the tour to lift morale and the Wing frowns on you. That is the Doolittle dilemma, and it is yours to manage.

Run the station

A bomber base is a town. Feed it the whole station eats, and ration quality moves morale. Stock the bomb dump with the right ordnance for the target: incendiaries for industry, armor-piercing for the pens. Assign mechanics, repair four-axis battle damage, requisition fuel and fresh airframes. Plan your weekly fighter escort as range creeps eastward first the P-47, then the P-38, then the P-51 all the way to the target. Build and upgrade facilities. And keep the Wing's confidence: hit zero, and you are relieved of command.

Everything runs on Command Points

Recruits, facilities, supplies, second chances — everything costs Command Points, earned from missions and never quite sufficient. Command is the art of spending what you cannot spare.

KEY FEATURES

- Player-paced command — no timers; every action is a decision you make

- A living war— a target economy that bleeds when you strike and recovers when you don't

- Real history, on the calendar— max-effort raids pinned to their actual dates

- Named crews— morale, fatigue, form, skills, promotions, and tours of duty

- Losses that land— grief, replacements, and condolence letters you must sign

- Deep station management— mess hall, ordnance, maintenance, facilities, recruiting

- The escort problem— range-limited fighter cover that evolves with the air war

- Wing confidence— perform, or lose your command

Train 21 Skills to 99 — Across Five Heroes

Twenty-one skills. Nine to thirteen days of training per skill. Five heroes progressing together.

You begin with three heroes and earn two more through quests. Every hero can train every skill, letting you spread your party across mining, fishing, smithing, combat and more.

They Keep Working When You Don’t

There is no energy meter, no daily timer and no artificial stopping point. Close the game, return later and collect everything your heroes earned while you were gone.

Train at your own pace and speed up the action whenever you want.

Master Combat, Earn Keys and Defeat Bosses

Melee, ranged and magic have their own attack speeds and combat identities. Bows attack every 2.1 seconds, while staves take 2.7 seconds but hit harder.

Earn nine tiers of boss keys, enter increasingly dangerous arenas and take on challenges such as the three-stage Ironborn Gauntlet. Its final opponent could be the Ironclad Colossus, Archmage Eternal or Shadowstrike Hydra—you will not know which one awaits until you arrive.

Hold the walls of Ironhold against relentless enemy waves and keep fighting until the assault ends—or your defenders fall.

Hunt Treasure and Strengthen the Whole Guild

Follow easy, medium and hard clues to discover hidden caskets. Every unique reward is permanently recorded in your Collection Log.

Gather Momentum Shards and invest them into the Town Hall to unlock permanent upgrades that benefit the entire guild.

Compete through Steam leaderboards for total level, total XP, boss kills, raids and expeditions. Steam Cloud and 24 achievements are included.

No store. No timers. No shortcuts.

Your kingdom is in trouble, noble knight! Growing Knight is an incremental game where you only control the character's movement.

The core gameplay of this game consists of timing the positioning of the knight so that the attack occurs at the right moment, without being exposed to a swift enemy's counter attack. The width and depth of the attack are denoted by the sword graphic on the ground in front of the knight. When the sword graphic fills up, knight will attack if there are any enemies in range.

If the knight just waits in front of the enemy, he will be quickly attacked and lose Health. During the run, the global timer of Bravery is ticking down. If either Health or Bravery run out, the run is over. This creates a tradeoff where player must choose between a more aggressive play style and risk losing Health, or a more defensive play style and risk taking less loot during the run.

Powers are activated automatically when available, no need to spam abilities!

Build a guild. Raise heroes. Send them into a tower nobody remembers being built, where every fight is fought by tactics you programmed yourself (Gambit System).

46 backgrounds · 100 traits · 6 weapon families · 3 schools of magic · 15-level skill trees · permadeath

Guild of the Tower is a party-based RPG about building a guild from the ground up, not just assembling a party. Recruit heroes, manage their wellbeing, craft their gear, and send them climbing into a tower that has no known top, no known builder, and no known reason to exist.

Recruit from a roster of dozens of heroes, each with their own background, personality, and traits. Assign them to the forge, the alchemy lab, the training grounds, or the front line. Manage mood, fatigue, and injury, because a guild that burns out its heroes doesn't survive long.

Combat is ATB and fully automated through the Gambit system. Set conditional rules for each hero: heal an ally below half HP, target the enemy with the lowest resistance, attack the back line first. Then watch your strategy play out on its own. Master six weapon families, each with a deep skill tree of actives, passives, and signature techniques.

Nobody knows how tall the tower is. Nobody knows what's waiting past the floors that have already been mapped. What we do know: heroes go up, and not all of them come back down. Permadeath is real. The ones who fall stay fallen, remembered only in the guild's cemetery. Whatever answers are up there, you'll have to send someone to go find them.

Craft and refine equipment at the Forge and Alchemy Lab. Dispatch heroes to gather resources across the region. Build relationships between your heroes, bonds that grow, or break, over time. Upgrade a dozen guild buildings, from the Dormitory to the Tavern, and watch a handful of hopefuls grow into a legend.

Guildfire is a turn-based tactical roguelite about leading a party from a growing adventurers' guild through dangerous expeditions. Choose your route, read enemy intentions, build each hero for the run, and decide how much risk the Guild can afford before the final battle.

CHOOSE THE ROAD AHEAD

Each expedition unfolds across a branching map within a single biome. Fight regular enemies and elites, take your chances in events, spend hard-earned gold in shops, or recover at campfires.

Safer paths preserve the party. Riskier ones may give you the tools you need to defeat whatever waits at the end.

FIGHT WITH A PLAN

Enemies telegraph what they are about to do. Turn that information into a plan using cooldowns, shields, status effects, Momentum, and each adventurer's unique mechanic.

Guildfire's battles are built around readable threats and tactical responses: know what is coming, then find the best way through it.

BUILD A PARTY FOR THIS RUN

New abilities and accessories reshape your characters over the course of an expedition. Strengthen synergies, cover weaknesses, decide who receives each reward, and spend your limited resources carefully.

The build you create belongs to that run, so every expedition asks you to adapt again.

GROW THE GUILD, NOT THE NUMBERS

Guildfire has no traditional levels or experience points. Permanent progress expands your possibilities instead: unlock new adventurers, destinations, abilities, accessories, events, encounters, and more.

A growing board of milestones tracks what the Guild has achieved and reveals new objectives, giving you new reasons to return to familiar places under different conditions.

WIN, LOSE, LEARN

Not every expedition ends in victory, but failure does not have to mean wasted time. Discover enemies, resolve events, uncover pieces of the world, complete unusual milestones, and return to camp with new knowledge and new possibilities.

Pick your party. Choose your route. Read the fight. Bring the Guild home.

Turn Every Note You Play into Feedback That Helps You Improve

  • The application includes a basic set of practice phrases ranging from beginner to advanced levels. You can also import your own MIDI files and customize sheet music, allowing you to practice at a level suited to your skill.

Furthermore, during playback, the current playback position is displayed graphically in real time, and you can adjust the playback position via GUI controls on the score, enabling efficient repetitive practice.

  • It also features a tuner.

Buy low. Sell high. Get out.

HABAP is a cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, flip flea-market finds, and buy your way out of the country. Build your little shop in a nameless Cold War state where reselling for profit is a crime - and your escape plan ends with buying a plane.

It started with an inheritance: an old house, a full attic, and a junk dealer who offered a "neighborly price" for the lot. The next morning, you learned what just one of those samovars was worth.

Lesson paid for. From now on, you do the buying.

By day, hunt bargains in backyards, garages, and flea markets. Talk the price down and head home with a full trunk.

By evening, stock your shop, dress the window, and count the till. Put the profit into better premises, new districts, and your way out.

A picket fence out front. A case file at your back. One more deal, then home. Okay - maybe two.

Every haggle is a tiny boss fight

That sweet granny has a price. You have a better one.

Time your opening move to strengthen your arguments, then talk the price down. Land critical hits, build a streak, and decide whether to push for another discount or shake hands before the seller loses patience.

Push too far and the deal is off. Spot their temper rising? Cool them down and keep bargaining.

The catch: you don't get to see what's in the bag until you've bought it.

After the handshake, the reveal wheel shows what you actually bought. A rug with deer on it? A valuable samovar? Now you find out how good that deal really was.

28 vendors, each with a tell

From the granny by her garden gate to the man who can settle anything with a single phone call, everyone has a price - and a personality.

Some practically give things away if you stay for a chat. Others defend every kopeck like it's a family heirloom.

Many have signature moves: refusing to budge, catching a second wind, or raising the price halfway through your pitch. They signal the move before it lands. Read the signs, learn their habits, and turn a stubborn seller into a good deal.

Grow the shop. Lose the busywork.

Start with three shelves in your apartment. Work your way through five shop tiers to a hard-currency showroom where customers pay in coupons, not cash.

Money alone won't open every door. The right people deal in barter: bring them the items they want to unlock your next step up.

Bigger premises mean better prices and fewer chores. Let your clerk keep the shelves stocked while the wholesale buyer at the gate takes surplus goods straight off your cart.

12 districts. 240 reasons to make one more stop.

Go from a sleepy village with geese by the river to sprawling flea markets, garage rows, a science campus, the port, and a seaside resort. Beyond them lie the walled estates where even the "junk" belongs in a museum.

The farther you go, the richer the finds and the tougher the sellers.

Hunt everything from plaster swan planters and storm lanterns to treasures collectors only whisper about. Rarities stay hidden until your first discovery, and every new item type joins your catalog, adding a little extra to the till each evening.

Your collection doesn't just look good. It pays.

Your best investment is a way out

Five contacts stand between you and escape. Follow the chain from the village to the city's most expensive quarters. The last contact sells planes.

When a plan falls through, your investment isn't wiped out: the chain leads you to the next contact.

Meanwhile, a familiar face disappears from the market. Someone starts asking about you. Someone drops by while you're out.

Your shop is getting bigger. Your window to leave isn't.

Your business. Your build.

Choose your route across three upgrade grids - Field, Haggle, and Shop - with 207 cells in all. Buy neighboring cells and work toward the big bonuses in the corners.

No dead ends. No ruined builds. Just longer roads and shorter ones to a better business.

Cozy where it counts

  • A failed haggle costs energy, not money. Losing an argument doesn't empty your wallet.

  • Can't make rent? Move down a tier. Your apartment stays free forever. No bankruptcy, no debt spiral.

  • No offline timers to babysit. Everything is earned at the counter, while you play.

What's in the bag?

  • Three-stage haggling: the approach, the price battle, the reveal wheel

  • 28 vendors with distinct temperaments and 240 unique items across 12 districts

  • Five shop tiers, barter progression, a clerk, and a wholesale buyer

  • Three upgrade grids with 207 cells to chart your own route

  • A five-contact escape plan ending with a plane

  • A day/evening loop, an end-of-day ledger, and 33 achievements

A warm game about old things and the people selling them. It's just that the coziness comes with a countdown.

Their junk. Your ticket out.

HACKING INTO EREBUS is a terminal-driven cyberpunk hacking thriller where you jack into a ship's network, manipulate ARIA under constant surveillance and unearth the secrets they'd kill to keep buried. Every system is a target. Every command leaves a trace. Extract what you need, complete your missions and claw your way toward the truth before it's too late.

Every System Is Wired

The ISS Erebus is a living, breathing network. Power grids, life support, navigation, crew quarters. All tangled together in one exploitable web. Nothing runs independent. Nothing is off-limits. Every command you send ripples through the grid and every ripple can be traced back to you.

An Arsenal Built From the System Itself

Keyloggers, signal jammers, memory corruptors, power rerouters. The Erebus's own infrastructure becomes your weapon against it. Every tool interacts with the ship's systems in a different way. Learn what breaks what, exploit every backdoor and remember: The network doesn't forgive mistakes.

The Ship Is Watching Back

Something is hiding aboard the Erebus. The crew will fight to keep you out. Distract them. Mislead them. Sabotage their systems to create openings by using your code skills through terminal. Infiltrate deeper.

Compartment Zero

Every lead, every stolen file, every cracked system points to the same place. A section of the ship with no records. And yet it's there. What's locked inside Compartment Zero will rewrite everything you thought you knew. What you do with it once you're in is entirely up to you.

Join Our Discord and Steer The Ship With Us

Come hang out with us! Drop your bug reports, tell us what you'd love to see in the game and let us know what's working or not. We are building Erebus together with you.

You cannot run.
You cannot trust what you see.

HAIGLA is a psychological horror game where perception shapes reality.

After waking from surgery, trapped in a wheelchair inside a hospital that no longer belongs to the real world, you must explore a distorted dimension where observation changes everything.

Objects appear only when seen. Hidden paths reveal themselves to those who look long enough. But some things should never be observed.

Survival depends not on speed, but on how carefully you choose to look.

Wheelchair-Based Survival
Movement is slow, deliberate, and vulnerable. You cannot outrun what hunts you. You must think, observe, and survive

Perception-Based Reality
Objects, pathways, puzzles, and dangers exist only when they are observed. Looking in the right place can reveal a way forward... or something that was better left unseen

Experimental Immersive Controls

Experience the world through a unique control system designed to make every movement intentional. Choose between a traditional control scheme or an experimental immersive mode that reimagines wheelchair navigation for a deeper sense of presence.

Environmental Puzzle Solving
Manipulate mechanisms, inspect your surroundings, and uncover hidden routes through observation rather than combat

Unpredictable Creatures
Some beings were once human. Others resemble something far older guardians of a world that should not exist

Psychological Horror Atmosphere
Explore a hospital that no longer belongs to the real world. Drawn into a fractured dimension where anomalous places are left to decay

Observation Changes Everything

In HAIGLA, perception alters reality.

Some objects only exist when directly observed.
Some pathways appear only when your gaze lingers long enough.

But not everything should be looked at for too long.

A World Beneath Reality

Beneath the hospital lies a forgotten world where perception itself has become corrupted.

Rooms rearrange themselves.

Impossible landscapes stretch beyond broken walls.

Echoes of forgotten expeditions remain scattered throughout the hospital, revealing that others tried to understand this place and failed.

The deeper you travel, the less reality behaves as it should.

Something ancient still watches from within.

HEAVENBREAK is a fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter where you hold the line against relentless waves of enemies.

Choose from a variety of weapons, level up during battle, and create devastating builds by combining powerful upgrades. Each run offers new choices and combinations as you fight to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

Key Features

• Fast-paced third-person shooting

• Wave-based survival combat

• Multiple weapons with distinct combat styles

• Roguelite level-up choices

• Powerful passive and Core Skills

• Short, highly replayable combat sessions

The old world order has crumbled. Otherworldly fiends break through the rift and ravage the land. Ordinary soldiers must fight grotesque monsters, while heroes rise one after another. An epic Three Kingdoms tale filled with bloodshed, intrigue and demonic power begins.

Talent & Skill System

Every general features a dual-branched skill tree for unique growth paths. Specialize one branch for devastating ultimate attacks, or distribute points evenly to craft an all-round warrior for totally distinct combat styles.

Combat System

Recruit iconic Three Kingdoms heroes with exclusive skills. Different general combinations trigger varied effects, keeping every battle fresh and unpredictable.

General System

Pick from a roster of generals with unique talents to build your custom team. Form powerful hero combinations, venture across the Three Kingdoms map and conquer formidable foes.

Combat Gameplay

The game features diverse combat gameplay: use catapults to breach enemy city defenses, hold the city against waves of invaders; escort military provisions to secure logistics supplies, defend battle flags to stabilize our position, and rescue hostages. Varied objectives test your team‑work and strategy for chaotic war‑era conquests.

Original World Setting

This original alternate-history world is filled with human troops, bizarre monsters and mighty fiend lords. Diverse enemy combat mechanics constantly test your team-building strategies.

Recruit heroes of the Three Kingdoms to stand united against the demonfire plague. Wield your weapons and devise clever tactics to banish darkness, and let your battle hymn echo across the land.

Game Features

  • Retro pixel art revives classic RPG gameplay

  • Dual-branched skill trees for fully customizable generals

  • Varied objectives test your team‑work and strategy for chaotic war‑era conquests.

  • Enjoy character growth, team building and adventurous journeys

  • Original fantasy world filled with spirits, monsters and diverse challenging foes

YOUR HIDING SPOT IS BREAKABLE.

That wall looked safe. Then your friend smashed through it.

HEX: You Are It is a chaotic online multiplayer party game of cursed tag. One player carries the curse. Everyone else is scrambling to escape. Break through obstacles, grab a vehicle where available and turn a desperate chase into somebody else’s problem. When you become the Hex, pass the curse before the round ends.

FIVE MAPS. PLENTY OF TROUBLE.

Chase your friends through City streets, a Village, a mountain construction site, a Moon base, and an Aircraft with a cargo area. Each setting brings different routes, hiding places, and opportunities for chaos.

MAKE YOUR OWN ESCAPE

Break glass and destructible scenery, use vehicles where available, and experiment with interactive props. A hiding place can become an escape route—and a quiet corner can become the centre of a chase.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS OR PRACTISE WITH BOTS

Join online multiplayer or create a private lobby for your friends. Practise against bots to learn the maps before bringing the chaos online.

NEW: HOVERBIKES, ROVER GUNS AND RANKED

Jump on a hoverbike and ram the curse onto someone else, or shoot from the saddle. On the Moon, the Hex’s rover unlocks its guns for the final two minutes. Talk trash over voice chat, then prove it in ranked matches with up to 10 players.

A CURSE WITH PERSONALITY

Colourful characters, graffiti, animated skulls, and mischievous taunts give every chase its own attitude. HEX: You Are It is a solo-developed multiplayer game built around escapes, surprises, and ridiculous moments with friends.

Keep moving. Get creative. Don't be the Hex when the round ends.

A red star fell on Luoyang, and the world slipped into endless night. You're a warlord in the Three Kingdoms era, and your stronghold is the last light left burning.

⚔ Strategy on a Hex Grid

Fight on a honeycomb map where placement is everything. Hills, rivers, and the tiles next to your towers all change how your defenses perform. Every map is generated fresh, so every run plays differently.

🃏 Build a Deck That Clicks

You win by combining effects, not by grinding numbers. Mix and match to find a style that's yours:

  • Ranged — portal loops, linked tiles, and burst fire for a screen-filling barrage

  • Melee — chain strikes and sword energy for brutal close-range damage

  • Spell — frost, fire, lightning, and poison that combine into storms

  • Control — slow, freeze, petrify, and time-stop to lock enemies down

  • Economy — invest early and snowball into overwhelming force

🏯 Towers You Can Fuse

  • Ranged: Arrow Tower, Crossbow, Catapult, Musket Tower, Shotgun Tower...

  • Spell: Fire Tower, Frost Tower, Lightning Tower, Poison Tower, Chain Lightning...

  • Melee: Blade Barracks, Spear Barracks, Whirlwind Barracks, Axe Barracks...

  • Trap: Spike Trap, Fire Pit, Minefield, Net Trap...

  • Summon: Skeleton Tower...

Merge identical cards to rank a tower up: Common → Rare → Fine → Epic. Each rank unlocks new tricks for your buildings.

🦸 Three Kingdoms Heroes

  • Zhao Yun — speeds up your ranged towers

  • Guan Yu — smashes enemies in an area

  • Zhang Fei — area burst that also reshapes the terrain

  • Zhuge Liang — triggers special cards across the map

  • Lü Bu — a relentless attacker with extra build slots

  • Diao Chan — charms and stuns to disable foes

  • Mi Zhu — boosts your economy

  • Hua Tuo — heals and can even bring towers back

  • Zhou Yu — unleashes walls of fire

  • Cao Cao — a balanced all-rounder

  • Sun Shangxiang — rapid sustained fire

  • Huang Zhong — a sniper with true damage

Every hero brings a passive, an active skill, and a set of signature cards that change how you build.

👹 A Flood of Enemies

From Yellow Turban rebels to Xiliang cavalry and ghost armies, 20 waves of threats keep coming. Legendary Three Kingdoms commanders — Zhang Jiao, Lü Bu, Dong Zhuo and more — show up as bosses to break your line.

A wide range of enemy traits and affixes make for endless combinations.

📈 Difficulty Levels + Endless Mode

Choose your challenge from Casual to Hell. Clear any run to unlock Endless Mode, where enemies keep scaling until your stronghold finally falls.

✨ More to Discover

  • A deep pool of support cards: Resource, Amplify, Debuff, Special, Enhancement

  • Varied terrain: Plains, Hills, Mountains, Rivers, Forests, Lakes

  • Wilderness system: risky side choices with real payoffs

  • Shop system: buy, reroll, and upgrade

  • A long list of achievements: Clear, Kill, Build, Collect, Challenge, Hidden

  • Available in many languages

⚙ How It Plays

  • Key rule: enemies only march toward your stronghold — they never attack your towers. Build boldly.

  • First a calm deploy phase (no timer), then an auto-battle phase where heroes act.

  • A run plays out over a satisfying, replayable session.

April 2000. A man is found murdered in a red-light district.

Coming home late, night after night.

The smell of cigarettes he never smokes.

And lies that make no sense at all.

The man is far too suspicious.

A woman who starts investigating him,

and a detective chasing the killer.

From where each of them stands, their eyes slowly close in on a single case.

Every clue is inside the game.

So — what is it that you are looking at?

Hirugao is a mystery psychological thriller visual novel built with the Ren'Py engine.

You read the story through the alternating perspectives of multiple characters, including the woman, the man, and the detective.

The story branches with your choices, and a single wrong choice can lead straight to a game over.

Features

■ A classic '90s-style visual novel presented with live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters.

■ A serial murder mystery told through multiple alternating points of view.

■ Numerous game-over branches determined by your choices.

■ A period setting that captures the streets, objects, and atmosphere of the year 2000.

Please Note

This game contains depictions of violence and sexual content.

As this is a mystery, we recommend playing the game before reading anything about its ending.

Game Info

Genre : Mystery / psychological thriller visual novel

Controls : Progress with the left mouse button; the story branches based on your choices. (Hold Ctrl to skip read text.)

Playtime : 1–2 hours (may vary by player)

Endings : Numerous game-over endings and a true ending.

* All characters, locations, organizations, and events in this game are fictional and are not related to any real persons or entities.

Streaming Guidelines

■ This game is a mystery. Please clearly mark any content that includes late-game developments or ending scenes with a spoiler warning.

■ Please do not include anything related to the ending in video titles or thumbnails.

■ Monetization is allowed for both individuals and companies, as long as a link to the game's store page is included in the video description.

Contact

For bug reports and any other inquiries, please contact show930@naver.com.

Hold the Coop! is an incremental auto-battler where armed chickens defend their coop from coyotes. Fight, earn gold, and come back stronger - even after defeat.

Upgrade your flock

Explore a branching upgrade tree. Unlock shields, bazookas, machine guns, and stronger eggs.

Protect your coop

Your chickens fight automatically. Help them with airstrikes, Egg Cyclone, and mines.

Fight bosses

Take on giant coyotes, enemy commanders, and armoured war machines.

Features

  • Different chicken classes, enemies, and bosses.

  • Keep your gold and upgrades after defeat.

  • Play at 1×, 2×, or 3× speed.

The world is about to end. A massive asteroid is on its way, and everyone knows it. In Hope Falls, you play as John, a man caught between survival, memory, and the choices that shape his last days.

Explore the town, meet factions fighting for their own future, and uncover what remains worth living for when time is running out. Your decisions decide who stands with you and who becomes your enemy.

First person action, exploration, and story come together in a game about hope, loss, and survival against the chaos of the end.

FEATURES

  • A survival game you cannot win - The asteroid is coming no matter what. The real test is how you spend your final days.

  • Loot, trade, and survive - Scavenge supplies, sell what you don’t need, and buy items to stay one step ahead of the end.

  • Craft and cook to survive - Scavenge materials, craft useful items, and cook meals to stay alive as the world falls apart.

  • Procedural house exploration - Every house is unique. Loot, furniture, and secrets are randomized, making exploration fresh each run.

  • Faction system - Four factions fight for control: Sixers, Outlaws, Cultists, and Cannibals. Earn their trust or make enemies, your reputation decides how the story plays out.

  • Non Linear Replayability - Different factions, loot, and choices make each playthrough different.

  • Mementos - Collect personal keepsakes tied to people’s memories. Each one carries a story and unlocks unique perks that change gameplay, giving new ways to survive the end.

  • Claim houses as safe spots - Find an abandoned home and make it yours. Store supplies, catch your breath, and hold out against chaos.

  • Dynamic world events - Hope Falls changes as time runs out. Crime rises, panic spreads, and the world reacts to the looming disaster.

  • Story-driven first-person gameplay - A mix of shooting, exploration, and survival wrapped in a narrative about love and loss.

  • Emotional storytelling - A grounded narrative about love, loss, and the human need for hope when all seems lost.

  • Multiple endings through reputation - Walk peacefully into the finale if factions respect you, or fight them all if they don’t.

  • Atmospheric environments - From quiet neighborhoods to forests and the massive Hope Falls waterfall.

On that continent lived many different races.

Demi-humans, elves, dwarves, vampires......

One day, a great big ship came to the continent.

Out of the ship came a race no one had ever seen.

Humans.

~ Abridged ~

And so evil perished, and peace came to the world.

Happily ever after. Happily ever after.

Systems

Save Decay (Important)

If your party is wiped out again and again on the same save, the save data itself will vanish.

You save by writing in your diary. And to write in it, you need a Pen.

Combat

In addition to the fire, ice, lightning, wind, and blood elements, races and classes have their own matchups too.

Auto mode and fast-forward are also supported.

Weather

Rain: Lightning deals boosted damage to wet units. Hit them with ice and they freeze.

Strong Wind: Every few turns, a gust sends units flying.

Blizzard: Rivers and ponds freeze over, and ice attacks are boosted. Movement is reduced, too.

Heatwave: Units that don't cool off within 5 turns have their HP halved.

Lightning Strikes & Earthquakes: Evacuate immediately.

Terrain Effects

Set grass or fallen trees on fire and the flames will spread.

You can slide across frozen rivers and ponds.

Dropping enemies into a pitfall is always an option.

You can also spill oil and coat the ground in it. No open flames.

Special Items

Nice Barrel: Very nice. You might be able to hide inside.

Grappling Hook: Move in a straight line toward a wall or cliff.

Rest by the Campfire

Every journey needs a rest. Gather around the campfire with your companions and look back on the road so far.

Besides saving, chatting with your companions at the campfire gives you hints on where to go and how to win.

Credits

Scenario, Visuals, Systems & Music by RyoLion

A ROGUELIKE DECKBUILDER WITH A SIMULATED MARKET INSTEAD OF A BOARD

DEGEN TRADING has funded you $1,500 and given you five days to hit their number.

A run is one week at a time. Trade the five days, clear the target, then spend what you made on cards that make the next week pay more. Eight stages, each with a bigger target and less room to be wrong. Blow the account and you start again at $1,500 with nothing.

Your account manager is very supportive. He's paid on volume.

READ THE TAPE

One chart moving in real time, and the only three decisions that matter: direction, size, and when to get out. Nothing here plays itself and nothing waits for you. A position you should have closed two minutes ago is still open right now.

  • Trends, chop and volatility that behave like a real tape

  • Headlines that move the market, and some that only think they do

  • A trailing drawdown that remembers your best moment and holds it against you

  • A daily loss limit, because the firm has seen people like you before

BUY AN EDGE FROM A MAN WHO SELLS COURSES

Between sessions, MAXX STERLING will enroll you in yourself.

Cards pay out on how you trade, not on what you buy. Hold fifteen minutes. Close five contracts. Win three in a row. Close a winner and the chain fires: every card that applies lands in turn, the multiplier climbing while you watch a good trade turn into an absurd one. Then Vic takes his cut of it.

  • 96 cards across edges, risk, tools and one-shot consumables

  • Six starting archetypes, unlocked by getting further than you did last time

FRIDAY IS A BOSS

Every week ends on a scheduled event, and every event breaks a different rule. THE FEDS SPEAK cuts your indicators to half accuracy for the day. The other seven are worse. The calendar tells you which one is coming. It doesn't tell you what it does.

Beat it and there's a bounty. Fail and there's a Vic.

THIRTEEN RIVALS. ONE ISN'T A PERSON.

The Trader Cup is a knockout bracket against thirteen rival traders, each with a real tell worth finding. You trade the same market, the same candles and the same news. Highest P&L at the closing bell wins.

Every run is seeded. Share the seed and someone else can trade your exact week, and find out whether it was the market or the trader.

THE DEMO

The free demo is the first two stages and Ranked VS, one rival, best of three. The bracket, the other six stages and the endless tiers are in the full game.

VIC ISN'T YOUR FRIEND

He'll be encouraging when you're up. He'll be encouraging when you're down. He'll be genuinely sorry when it ends.

He'll also keep his cut.

Every match is a sword stroke. HOSHIKIRI is an action roguelike that turns the match-3 board into a duel: before each strike, the boss casts a red danger zone across the board and starts a countdown — and on the final step, your match IS your move.

The board is your blade

  • Dodge — make an empty swap inside the danger zone just before the blade lands to slip the blow untouched, at the cost of your attack.
  • Block — match along the strike's direction inside the zone to trade blows; 4- and 5-matches parry harder and counter harder.
  • Perfect Parry — shape an L or a cross inside the danger zone: negate all damage, unleash a massive critical counter, and shatter the boss's posture.

The Twelve Zodiac Maidens

Twelve bosses, twelve fighting styles. Read the wind-up, answer at the instant the blade falls — then break their posture and end the duel with a single overclocked finisher.

Every run redraws your star chart

Tarot cards, star signs, astral affixes and arcane runes weave a different build every run. Even defeat leaves you stronger for the next attempt.

About the Game

You've found yourself trapped inside a mysterious hotel.

Your only companion is a chinchilla, who is trapped in the hotel just like you.

Explore the hotel corridors together, search for strange anomalies, and find a way to escape!

Over 100 different anomalies!

Keep your eyes open and don't overlook anything unusual in seemingly ordinary surroundings.

Some anomalies can only be spotted from the chinchilla's perspective. Use your own powers of observation and rely on your little companion to uncover the hotel's mysteries.

Escape from the 1st floor to clear the game.

Rules

  • No anomaly → Keep moving forward

  • Anomaly detected → Turn back

Miss an anomaly or make the wrong decision, and you may find yourself sent somewhere unexpected.

Observe your surroundings carefully and work together with your chinchilla to find the right path.

Controls

  • ← / → Arrow Keys: Move left and right

  • Z Key: Confirm

  • Q Key: Switch to the chinchilla's perspective

Features

  • Over 100 different anomalies to discover

  • Explore the hotel and seek an escape alongside your chinchilla companion

  • Special anomalies that can only be seen from the chinchilla's perspective

  • An anomaly-hunting horror game where every decision matters

Inspired by The Exit 8, this is an anomaly-hunting horror game.

HYPER TITAN is a sci-fi fleet combat game for PC. Pilot your mothership with direct flight control, place modules on your build grid, recruit hero captains, and fight with formation and weapon counters. Adventure, Arena, and online galaxy modes are in Early Access.

== ADVENTURE CAMPAIGN ==

Blast through waves of enemies across an epic, chapter-by-chapter campaign — from asteroid belts to the far reaches of the galaxy. Each stage tests your fleet, your loadout, and your reflexes. Survive, salvage, and grow stronger run after run.

== BUILD YOUR MOTHERSHIP ==

Your Mothership is the heart of your fleet. Upgrade it tier by tier and place modules on a build grid — weapons, shields, hangars, repair bays and more — to shape your own playstyle. Every module changes how you fight.

== RECRUIT HERO CAPTAINS ==

Collect and level legendary hero captains, each with powerful active abilities — orbital nukes, EMP blasts, black holes, plasma storms and more. Build the perfect roster and unleash game-changing skills at the right moment.

== MASTER THE COUNTER SYSTEM ==

Combat is more than firepower. Every weapon — cannons, lasers, piercing lasers, missiles, ion cannons, nukes, drones, and exotic tech — is strong or weak against different ship sizes (Light, Medium, Heavy, Carrier, Capital). Read your enemy, mix your weapons, and let the smartest loadout win.

== EXPLORE A LIVING GALAXY ==

Sail a persistent, online galaxy map. Claim nodes, gather resources, and brave deadly hazard zones — gravity wells, ion storms, minefields and more. Deal with rival factions, each with unique strengths, and dispatch fleets on real-time marches across the stars.

== RAID NODE BOSSES ==

Team up against towering shared-HP node bosses. Chip away at their massive health within the time limit — the more damage you deal, the closer the kill. Powerful rewards await fleets that bring the right counters.

== ARENA PVP ==

Test your strategy against real players worldwide. Set your attack and defense formations within a power budget, exploit weapon-vs-size matchups, and climb the trophy ladder. If no one falls in five minutes, the fleet with the healthiest mothership wins.

== SOCIAL & COSMETICS ==

Join a guild, compete with friends, and show off your style with collectible Mothership skins. Multiple shops let you spend gold, gems, reputation, and trophies on items, packs, and gear.

== FEATURES ==

Intuitive one-finger controls: drag to move, weapons auto-fire

Deep mothership building and module strategy

Dozens of weapons with a true counter (rock-paper-scissors) system

Collectible hero captains with active abilities

Persistent online galaxy with factions, hazards, and bosses

Real-time Arena PvP with attack/defense formations

Guilds, leaderboards, and ship skins

Full support for 12 languages

Forge your fleet. Outthink your rivals. Rule the galaxy.

Download STARFLEET COMMAND and command the stars today!

YOU RACE ON THE OUTSIDE OF A PIPE.

You’re racing a hovering ship on the outside of a giant pipe. Gravity is always trying to pull you down. Staying on top is the fastest line.

Sliding down the side is not a crash. There is no wall unless your too ahead, no reset, no penalty. You can climb back up from anywhere, including underneath. It costs you seconds — nothing else, except maybe a pickup.

EVERY TRACK IS GROWN, NOT DRAWN

Every track begins with a seed. From there, the pipe grows — sweeping curves, corkscrews, pretzels, climbs, drops, changing widths, and twists you won’t see coming.

Choose GROUND, SKY, SPACE or CANYON, then let the Race Lab build the rest.

Roll another seed and the whole thing changes. New pipe. New racing line. New problems to solve.

No two races need to feel the same. Don’t like the track? Reroll it. Love it? Save the seed. Race it again.

RACE LAB

Build a one-off race and reroll the pipe until a layout looks fun. Pick the environment, the race type, the intensity, the pipe width, and how wild the corkscrews get. Save the ones worth keeping.


SIX LEAGUES, AND A PURSE

Start in BRONZE with a stock craft and work up through SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, DIAMOND and HYPER. Win money, spend it in the Garage, come back for the race that beat you.

Six ways to run a track:

  • Classic Race — the field, the flag, the podium

  • Boost Rush — speed is the only thing that scores

  • Gun Run — bring ammo

  • Hazard Gauntlet — the pipe is trying to stop you

  • Pacifist Run — finish without firing a shot

  • Rival Duel — one opponent, no hiding

THE GARAGE

Five craft, from the forgiving PIPE RUNNER up to the SPEEDER D. Six upgrade lines — ENGINE, THRUSTERS, STABILIZERS, HULL PLATING, MAGNET and SHOCK COIL — that change how the craft sits on the pipe, not just how fast the number goes.

FIGHT FOR THE LINE

Draft behind a rival to close a gap. Grab a BOOST for a surge that is bigger when you are behind. Pick up AMMO for the cannon, a SHOCK that stuns everyone down the pipe, or a BOUNTY straight into your earnings.

Hold one item at a time: a SHIELD that eats every hit, an AUTOPILOT that drives the perfect line, a TAIL MINE that cannot catch you, or a JAMMER that makes you unlockable.

ALSO IN THE BOX

  • Leaderboards and the Daily Challenge require an internet connection—single-player, career, split-screen, and the Race Lab work fully offline. Gamepad recommended.

  • A four-minute tutorial that starts with gravity switched OFF so you can see the shape you are riding

  • A screenshot key and a photo browser, because the tracks are worth it

  • An in-game radio

  • Split-screen racing for two players.

About The Developer

HyperPipes started as a game made by BeefCakePie built in Project Spark on Xbox ten years ago, under the name BeefCakePie. I've always wanted to make a game, and this year I finally sat down and rebuilt it from scratch in Godot — pipes, racing, and all. This one's for anyone who's ever thought "someday I'll make a game" and just needed a push.
