Every animal needs a home. You know how to build one.

Habitat is a turn-based strategy game played on a hand-sculpted clay world. Each turn you draft animals and terrain, then place tokens on the hex board to grow the exact landscape each creature needs — a pig wants its farm and a splash of water; a heron wants the river bend to itself. Complete a pattern and the animal settles in, alive on your board from then on.

The seasons keep turning. Spring rain, summer bloom, winter's bright hush — each season shifts what thrives, and phenomena like rainbows, monsoons and Starfall sweep across the land to bend your plans.

Grow your knowledge. Unlock technologies, gather artifacts with strange old powers, chase milestones, and fill your compendium — a naturalist's journal spanning 49 animals and the history of biome art
itself.

Play it your way. A full solo game, or online with 2–4 players — invite Steam friends straight from the lobby.

🕯️ The Story of Halloween Night

Every Halloween night, the ghosts carry pumpkin lanterns and throw a party, and the witch coven can't resist bringing out a set of fun and absurdly over-the-top magic tools. As the new apprentice wizard, you must use the art of orb-matching to clear the troublemaker balls and stop the candy cellar from overflowing — legend says that when your combo keeps extending under the full moon, the Candy Sprite will appear!

🧩 Basic Rules (5 Seconds to Learn)

  • The 9×9 magic board has 81 cells in total. Match 5 or more spirit orbs in a straight line — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — to eliminate them and score points.

  • Select an orb and click an empty cell to move it; if the path is blocked, the move fails. Try a different approach or use a tool to clear the way.

  • After each move, if no elimination is formed, the new orbs in the preview area will drop onto the board — use the Hourglass to slow them down.

  • A precious wild Sun Orb sits on the board, and it can substitute for any color to help you complete lines with ease.

  • The round ends when the board fills up and there are no moves left — stay calm and don't panic; with tools in hand, you can still turn the situation around even when all seems lost.

🧪 Ten Magical Tools

  • 🍬 Candy (Single Clear): precisely eliminate a single orb to free up a key position

  • 🔍 Magnifier (Predict): reveal the landing spots of new orbs in advance for first-move planning

  • 💊 Capsule (Twin Clear): two same-colored orbs vanish together with a "pop"

  • 🚪 Teleport (Relocate): instantly move an orb to any empty cell, ignoring all obstacles

  • 🧬 Clone (Duplicate): copy a same-colored orb to a target position

  • 💣 Bomb (Area): clear a 3×3 zone

  • 🔥 Fireball (Straight Line): sweep an entire row or column in the chosen direction

  • 🚀 Missile (Same Color): lock on and clear every orb of one color across the whole board

  • ⚡ Lightning (Area): strike randomly and eliminate about half of the balls

  • ⏳ Hourglass (Control): freeze new orb spawns for 5 turns

The gem cost of each tool varies by difficulty, so plan carefully before using them~

🔥 Combos & Gems: Blow Your Score Sky-High

  • Consecutive eliminations trigger a combo state, where your score and gems multiply and the sound effects and visuals become increasingly explosive

  • Starting from a 3-combo, you randomly earn free tools; a 7-combo or higher directly grants the strongest tool, "Lightning"

  • ⚠️ Using a tool to eliminate orbs directly will break your combo — if you're chasing the combo leaderboard, resist the urge to slip

  • Gems dropped from eliminations are the currency for buying tools; cumulative eliminations also raise your Gem Level (1-10) — the higher the level, the more gems each elimination drops

👻 Meet the Characters

  • 🧙 You — the new apprentice wizard, shouldering the mission of saving the candy cellar

  • 🎃 Pumpkin lanterns — the vibe-setters of the Halloween party

  • 👻 The ghosts — mischievous floaters: tap one and it shyly fades away, and it bounces off when the mouse hovers over it

  • 🧹 The Witch — the leader of the witch coven; all the tools are family heirlooms

  • 🍬 The Candy Sprite — a mysterious being that exists only in the legend of full-moon combos

🏆 Achievements & Leaderboards

50+ achievements: from "Elimination Rookie" to "Elimination Legend," and from "Combo Rookie" to "Combo Myth,"

plus challenges such as "Clean Sweep" (clear 17 orbs in a single line), "Bare-Handed Victory" (eliminate 10,000 orbs without using any tools), and "Master of All Tools,"

collect them all to light up the ultimate achievement "Halloween Night Legend"! It also supports the global Steam leaderboards, so you can compete with wizards from all over the world.

🎮 Feature Highlights

  • Three difficulty levels: Easy (5 colors) / Normal (6 colors) / Hard (7 colors) — something for both newcomers and veterans

  • Anywhere, anytime, jump into a round and unwind with ease
